_about: Skills trigger corpus — labelled, SYNTHETIC (skills-s13-plan.md §3.1 / W5 audit §6.4/§8.3). Text
only: NO user data, no real statements, no telemetry — honours the offline/no-user-data rules.
Each item: { id, question, inScopeDocs:[{title,mimeType}], expected:<skillId|'none'>, confusion?, scope?, note }.
`scope` (U4/§4.4): 'narrowed' (default) = the inScopeDocs are EXPLICITLY selected (attachment / hand-pick),
seen by BOTH suggestion + auto-fire; 'whole-corpus' = they merely EXIST in a collection the conversation is scoped to,
so the inert suggestion offer still reads them but AUTO-FIRE narrows them away (contributes no corroborating signal).
Label space = ALL NINE real ENABLED app skills' actual triggers (W5 widened it from 4; Phase 8 added document-edit):
bank-statement | invoice | meeting-protocol | contract-brief | share-safe-review |
deadline-obligation-finder | what-changed | document-redaction | document-edit | none.
`confusion:true` marks a CROSS-SKILL pair the SUGGESTION bar must get right (fired-wrong 0 and missed 0 on the set).
`note` records WHY the label is what it is (the hard case it exercises); it is not scored. Rows whose note starts
'carried from <test file>' were moved here verbatim from the per-skill trigger tests they replaced; rows whose note
starts 'pins a keyword listed by <test file>' are new questions that each exercise one keyword that test listed.
HOW IT RUNS: tests/eval/skill-triggers.ts scores every row through the PRODUCTION paths — `suggestSkillsForTurn`
(the offer) and `resolveAutoFireSkill` (the silent fire) — on one real temp database with the committed app-skills/
reconciled; each row gets its own isolated scope. Every row must give its expected offer. The ONLY exceptions are
the two maps in tests/eval/skill-triggers.test.ts: KNOWN_SUGGESTION_DEVIATIONS (the offer differs from the label) and
KNOWN_AUTOFIRE_DEVIATIONS (auto-fire applies a different skill than the label). A deviation that gets fixed must be
REMOVED from its map — a stale entry fails the suite.
Questions are CONTENT: the harness scores them, never logs them (skills-s13-plan.md §6).
